name: lamps
notes: Pedestrian crossing: the lamps of each phase (the code of the state diagram traffic.fsm.json: 0 CARS, 1 CARS_YELLOW, 2 ALL_RED, 3 WALK, 4 WALK_END, 5 ALL_RED_2, 6 NIGHT; 7 is never used: don't care). blink (2 Hz, from the timer) makes the pedestrian green blink in WALK_END and the cars' yellow flash at NIGHT.
